summary: The one remaining screen is the C --More-- prompt after the magic harp reaches music.c:charm_monsters. Its first in-range monster is the adjacent level-1 orc: charm_monsters calls resist(TOOL_CLASS, 0, NOTELL), then (because the orc has zero MR) calls tamedog. tamedog’s visible “seems more amiable” message is too long to share the existing harp line, so topl.c:update_topl() calls more() before replacing it. JS skips charm_monsters at note_unported and moves to exercise instead; the first RNG mismatch is C resist rn2(109)=89 versus JS exercise rn2(19)=17. The recording ends at the pager, before the post-pager taming state is visible.

source.branch: music.c:do_improvisation(MAGIC_HARP) passes distance (u.ulevel - 1) / 3 + 1 to charm_monsters() after consuming a charge and printing the harp message. charm_monsters() sets distance to zero if u.uswallow, preserving only a collocated engulfer; it traverses fmon while saving mtmp->nmon before each effect, skips dead monsters, and considers monsters with mdistu(mtmp) <= distance. For each in range it calls resist(mtmp, TOOL_CLASS, 0, NOTELL); if the consumed Boolean result is false, or the monster is a shopkeeper, it calls tamedog(mtmp, NULL, TRUE) and discards that return. In this recording, the level-1 hero’s magic harp gives distance 1 and the adjacent orc is at squared distance 1. The orc has m_lev 1 and MR 0, so C’s logged rn2(109)=89 makes resist false and enters tamedog.
callers: C: apply.c:doapply() sends MAGIC_HARP through music.c:do_play_instrument(); js/apply.js:doapply() routes the same inventory arm to js/music.js:do_play_instrument().
C: music.c:do_play_instrument() accepts the recorded “y” answer to Improvise? and calls do_improvisation(); js/music.js:do_play_instrument() sends the yes/default answer to do_improvisation().

C: music.c:do_improvisation(MAGIC_HARP) consumes the charge, prints the music message, calls charm_monsters((u.ulevel - 1) / 3 + 1), then exercises Dexterity; js/music.js has the same arm but replaces the helper call with note_unported("music.c charm_monsters") before exercise().

C: charm_monsters() calls zap.c:resist() and, when its result is false or the monster is a shopkeeper, dog.c:tamedog(); the latter call’s Boolean result is explicitly discarded. The visible tamedog() pline reaches win/tty/topl.c:update_topl()/more().
dependencies: hack.h:mdistu(mon) expands to distu()/hacklib.c:dist2(); JS hacklib.js:dist2() already implements the squared-Euclidean distance used by the inclusive <= distance gate.
zap.c:resist() returns a Boolean consumed by charm_monsters(); js/zap.js:resist() already ports the formula and accepts the existing musicRandom.rn2 source.

dog.c:tamedog(mon, NULL, TRUE) is a side-effect call whose Boolean result C discards; js/dog.js:tamedog() already implements it and must be awaited for its messages and state changes without consuming its return.

tamedog() has separate named gaps outside the ordinary orc path: shk.c:make_happy_shk for a shopkeeper, mhitu.c:expels when the charmed monster is u.ustuck while swallowed unless the expels hook is supplied, and worm.c:redraw_worm for a worm. Preserve these downstream gaps; the saved recording stops at the More prompt before the ordinary orc’s post-pager taming tail.
pline.c:pline_mon() routes tamedog’s visible message to win/tty/topl.c:update_topl()/more(); js/tty_message.js already models the same message-page boundary.
